jobs.title: Technical Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.

Problem-solving with a purpose.

As a Technical Solutions Engineer at Epic, you’ll work on software that impacts 305 million patients around the world. Alongside customer counterparts, you’ll tackle mission-critical and complex problems – we’re way beyond “turn it off and on again” issues. You’ll need to diagnose the problem, identify a solution, and manage the implementation of the solution, sometimes across multiple physical locations and stakeholders. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/Jobs/Technical-Solutions-Engineer.

Test the limits of your brain for the most innovative health systems on the planet.

The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.

Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.

Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).

More than just important work
.

Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.

We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.

Bachelor's degree or greater
A history of academic excellence or professional success
Willingness to travel occasionally to customer locations
Eligible to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship
Relocation to the Madison, WI area (reimbursed)
COVID-19 vaccination

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description

Pay Range: $25.89 - $32.37 Hourly (DOE)

Branch Location: 22419 72nd Ave S Kent, WA 98032

Restoration Management Company expects each, and every employee to embrace and apply in their daily activities the following company CORE VALUES: Team Spirit, Integrity, Quality, Humility, and Safety. These, in addition to the requirements listed below, are essential to the success of your career with Restoration Management Company.

Job Summary

Project Coordinator is responsible for scheduling and dispatching crews to residential and commercial property losses. This position supports one or more of the following: Project Managers, Project Supervisors, Superintendents, Branch Managers, and Directors with administrative duties when needed. Serve as the liaison to corporate office for all new forms, policies, procedures, and program issues.

Key Responsibilities

Core responsibilities for the position are as follows:

Call customers for purposes of communicating or coordinating project schedules, and/or respond to general inquiries in a timely manner.
Responsible for assisting with Vendor Setup ensuring vendor has provided correct documentation.
Answer phone calls from customers, answer questions, or direct to appropriate staff when necessary.
Generate Work Orders and Change Orders upon request, forward to customer for signature, and coordinate dispatch of crews accordingly.
May be responsible for maintaining daily schedules for crews and other project members, and may assist in establishing schedules for increased efficiencies.
May prepare required state, federal, and / or waste management paperwork for all Asbestos
Projects, where applicable.
Update Invoice Tracking spreadsheet and ensure delivery of Payment Request to management.
Organize weekly, bi-weekly, monthly meetings in accordance with company policy, including but not limited to: safety meetings, In-office meetings, production meetings, etc.
Work with Call Center regarding new job information.
Label photos and upload into specific systems/programs.
Create and maintain job files ensuring all job pertinent reports and documents, including budget worksheets, invoices, Project Reports and BOS are properly filed.

Reporting (these duties may be applicable, depending on Division/Department):

Prepare daily management report on T&M Cost Spreadsheet, cross checking against subcontractor invoice and labor hours. Submit complete and accurate T&M paperwork daily to Central Billing.
Document daily updates on industry specific programs for all open jobs. Enter information from Tick Sheets completed by the Technicians and Project Managers into industry specific programs (Moisture Mapper, Xactanalysis, and Mica reports).

Branch office support may include:

Distribute and send all US mail and interoffice mail (courier service) for the Branch.
Monitor visitor access when required, ensuring all protocols (safety/corporate) are followed.
Ensure all local, state, and federal postings as directed by HR and Safety are properly displayed.
Organize timecards by division and review for errors. Where applicable enter hazard pay data and/or verify construction labor; submit to Payroll.
Communicate with and assist Payroll and Human Resources with payroll and employee issues.
Responsible for keeping petty cash supply balanced, authorizing reimbursements and
tracking cash flow for submission to corporate office. (Except for Corporate)
Keep adequate levels of office supply inventory, RMC apparel, and order when necessary.
Provide administrative support to: Branch Manager, Project Supervisor,
Project Managers, Operations Manager, Technicians and Human Resources.
Download documents and pictures into appropriate job folder for billing.
Serve as point of contact to all office and/or project vendors, customers, and field personnel.
Participate in production meetings.
Serve as liaison to corporate office for new forms, policies, and procedures.

Experience/Requirements

The position of Project Coordinator requires the following:

High School Diploma or equivalent.
Proven work experience in a restoration or construction industry preferred.
Use of good judgement and discretion with handling confidential data.
Good knowledge in working with MS Office
Customer service focus, with excellent interpersonal skills.
Good grasp of English
Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Multi-tasker, with ability to meet tight deadlines, works well under pressure.
Ability to follow directions, utilize resources.
High attention to detail, accuracy, and proofreading

Safety Requirements

Regulatory Requirements: Adhere to all local, state, and federal safety regulations, including OSHA and EPA standards.
Personal Protective Equipment (PPE): Required PPE may include gloves, masks, goggles, hard hats, and safety footwear. All employees must wear PPE as required for their specific roles and job site conditions.
Ergonomic Practices: Practice ergonomic principles to prevent musculoskeletal disorders. This includes proper desk setup, using adjustable chairs, and maintaining good posture while seated.
Office Safety Protocols: Adhere to established office safety protocols to maintain a secure work environment. This includes the following guidelines for the proper use of office equipment and ensuring that workspaces are free from clutter to prevent trips and falls.
Safety Training: Complete all mandatory safety training sessions, including but not limited to hazard communication, emergency response, and safe equipment handling.
Reporting Safety Concerns: Ability to identify and immediately report any unsafe conditions, hazards, incidents or injuries to supervisors without fear of retaliation.
Emergency Procedures: Familiarize yourself with emergency procedures relevant to your specific job site, including evacuation routes, and emergency contacts.

Physical Requirements

General Physical Abilities:

Lifting and Carrying: Ability to lift and carry materials or equipment weighing up to 25 lbs. regularly and up to 50 lbs. with assistance.
Physical Activities: Ability to perform tasks that require, walking, bending, reaching, crouching, kneeling, climb, squat, crawl, lift above shoulder, reach, and twist.
Sitting and Standing: Prolonged sitting or standing required (in office, driving and/or at job sites). Regular alternating between sitting and standing
Repetitive Motions: Continuous repetitive motion and tasks involving L/R hand movement (computer/mouse), wrists, or arms (e.g., typing, data entry).
Machinery Operation: Capacity to operate machinery and tools as required by job tasks, which may involve fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination.
Visual Ability: requirement for clear vision (e.g., close work, computer use, eye coordination)

Working Conditions

Office Environment:

Indoor office setting for corporate roles, including working with standard office equipment (computers, phones, printers). May involve regular meetings, (in person or zoom) and collaboration with team members.

Field Environment:

Outdoor fieldwork at restoration sites, which may include residential, commercial, or industrial properties. Duties may involve exposure to different weather conditions (sun, rain, snow, heat).

Hazardous Environments:

Potential exposure to hazardous materials, chemicals, or contaminants specific to restoration work, requiring strict adherence to safety protocols and use of PPE.
Work after hours and weekends given our 24/7 business operations

Travel Requirements:

May include travel to and from job sites, requiring the use of company vehicles. Possibility of attending out-of-town training or conferences.

Req Number ADM-26-00010

About the Organization Restoration Management Company, Northern California's largest emergency service / restoration company is a growing, profitable, privately held company headquartered in Livermore, California. Established in 1985, Restoration Management Company has been providing reliable, year round emergency service, 24-hours-a-day for water, smoke and environmentally damaged property - to commercial, industrial, and residential clients.

We offer:

Full-time positions;
Opportunity for advancement;
Competitive benefits (medical, dental, vision, EAP, 401k and matching, and life insurance)
PTO
Paid holidays
Competitive salaries

Job Description

Creates zoning, historic, annexation, and other maps using data and geographic information. Generates addressing plats and updates street name list and range maps.

Essential Functions/ Job Competencies/ Physical Requirements

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

The intent of this job description is to provide a representative summary of the major duties and responsibilities performed by employees in this job. Employees may be requested to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically presented in this description.

Generates addressing plats utilizing Geographic Information Systems and drawing tools.
Updates street name list by comparing the new subdivision plats versus the GIS data and existing plats.
Performs technical duties in the maintenance, development, and operation of the geographic information systems.
Creates, maintains, and edits departmental shape files and layers.
Prepares a variety of analysis of electronic information, including the preparation of multi-layered and linked maps and tabular data; prepares graphic materials and assists staff in interpreting the results.
Ensures the quality and accuracy of a variety of geographic information system data, including researching and revising maps and data from other data sources.

jobs.title: Senior Survey Technician
jobs.description:
Artheon is seeking talented professionals to join our growing team in support of diverse engineering and environmental projects. Whether your background is in civil engineering, environmental science, or infrastructure design, this is a great opportunity to contribute to meaningful work in a collaborative and innovative environment.

About Artheon

Artheon is a trusted engineering and consulting firm offering services that rival large organizations while maintaining the personalized client relationships of a boutique firm. With expertise spanning civil/site engineering, environmental permitting, transportation infrastructure, construction management, and advanced surveying technologies, we are committed to delivering high-quality, timely solutions to local, state, and federal clients.

About The Role

As a Senior Survey Technician, you will lead daily field operations, oversee data collection, and ensure survey work is performed accurately, efficiently, and safely. You’ll work closely with project managers, engineers, and office staff to support projects including boundary surveys, topographic surveys, construction layout, and municipal infrastructure work.

This role is ideal for someone with surveying experience who is confident in the field, capable of working independently, and ready to take responsibility for crew performance, data quality, and project execution.

Responsibilities

Field Operations & Survey Execution

Lead and manage survey crews in the field on a variety of projects including boundary, topographic, construction stakeout, and right-of-way surveys
Plan daily field activities, coordinate logistics, and ensure efficient execution of assigned work
Perform property and right-of-way reconnaissance and verify existing conditions
Operate and maintain survey equipment including total stations, GPS/GNSS, and data collectors

Data Collection & Quality Control

Ensure accurate and complete field data collection and documentation
Review field data for accuracy, completeness, and consistency before submission
Coordinate with office staff to support data processing, mapping, and final deliverables
Troubleshoot field issues and adjust methods as needed to maintain quality and efficiency

Project Coordination

Work closely with project managers and engineers to understand project scope, schedule, and requirements
Support construction layout and coordination with contractors and field personnel
Participate in project meetings as needed and communicate field progress, challenges, and updates

Leadership & Team Development

Provide direction, training, and mentorship to instrument operators and junior field staff
Promote a team-oriented environment focused on safety, quality, and productivity
Ensure all work is performed in accordance with company standards, project requirements, and safety protocols

Qualifications

Qualifications

1+ years of land surveying experience, with demonstrated field leadership
Strong working knowledge of survey field procedures, equipment, and data collection methods
Experience with boundary, topographic, construction, and/or municipal surveying projects
Ability to work independently, manage field crews, and make sound decisions in the field
Strong communication skills and ability to coordinate effectively with field teams, office staff, and clients
Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to project sites as needed
Certified Survey Technician (CST) or NICET Surveying Technician Certification preferred (or ability to obtain)

Benefits

Pay Transparency:

The base salary (or hourly rate) range for this role is indicated in the posting. This range reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location.

Artheon offers a competitive compensation package including medical, prescription, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) retirement plan with employer match, educational assistance program and paid time off/parental leave.

About The Company

BCforward is a prominent global IT consulting and workforce solutions firm dedicated to delivering innovative technology solutions and staffing services to Fortune 500 companies and government agencies. Established in 1998, BCforward has built a reputation for excellence by fostering long-term client relationships, emphasizing integrity, collaboration, and innovation. With extensive delivery centers and offices across North America and India, the company is committed to empowering organizations through tailored IT solutions and strategic talent acquisition. BCforward’s core mission is to support clients in achieving their digital transformation goals while providing meaningful career opportunities for its employees.

About The Role

The Data Analyst IV (Customer Experience and Support Analyst) is a critical role within BCforward’s client support and customer experience team. The successful candidate will leverage advanced data analytics, customer feedback analysis, and operational insights to enhance customer satisfaction and support efficiency. This remote position requires a professional with a strong background in data science, statistical analysis, and customer support metrics, capable of translating complex data into actionable strategies. The role involves identifying trends, diagnosing root causes of customer issues, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to implement improvements. The analyst will advocate for customers by providing insightful reports and recommendations to influence service enhancements and operational excellence. Familiarity with AI tools, Salesforce, and data visualization platforms is essential for success in this role.

Qualifications

Ideal candidates will possess over six years of experience in data analytics, data science, or related fields, with a strong proficiency in SQL and statistical analysis techniques. A solid understanding of customer experience metrics such as Net Promoter Score (NPS), Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), and voice of customer feedback is required. Experience with customer support operational metrics and the ability to communicate complex insights effectively to non-technical stakeholders are critical. Candidates should have hands-on experience with statistical tools like R or Python and familiarity with AI analytics tools. A master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline is preferred. Additionally, three or more years of experience in customer support or service analytics, along with knowledge of Generative AI, ML, and predictive analytics, will be advantageous.

Responsibilities

The primary responsibilities of this role include analyzing operational data, customer feedback, and support transcripts to identify patterns, trends, and pain points across support channels. The analyst will monitor feedback sources to detect emerging issues, conduct root cause analysis, and develop insights to inform service improvements. They will integrate various data sources—transactional, behavioral, and operational—to map experience drivers and prioritize areas for intervention. The role involves advocating for customers through periodic and ad-hoc reporting, presenting findings to stakeholders, and influencing corrective actions. The analyst will collaborate with cross-functional teams to diagnose support issues, develop remediation plans, and evaluate their effectiveness over time. Utilizing AI analytics tools, Salesforce, and Hive, the candidate will deliver actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and improve overall customer experience. Additionally, the role involves staying updated on emerging AI and analytics technologies to enhance analytical capabilities and automate routine tasks.

Benefits

BCforward offers a competitive compensation package aligned with industry standards, along with comprehensive benefits that support employee well-being and professional development. Employees gain opportunities to work with leading global clients on innovative projects, fostering growth and skill enhancement. The company promotes a supportive and inclusive work environment that values diversity and encourages collaboration. Employees have access to cutting-edge technologies and training resources, enabling them to stay at the forefront of industry trends. BCforward also provides flexible remote work arrangements, allowing for a healthy work-life balance and increased productivity. Career advancement opportunities are available for high performers, with pathways to senior roles and specialized expertise within the organization.

Equal Opportunity

BCforward is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We value the unique perspectives and experiences of all employees and applicants. Our hiring practices are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate against any individual on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and the opportunity to contribute to our mission of delivering excellence through innovation and collaboration.

jobs.title: Lead Data Analyst
jobs.description:
We are seeking an analytically rigorous and business-oriented Lead Data Analyst to help transform how our newsroom, product, marketing, and advertising teams use data to grow digital subscriptions and audience engagement. This role combines SQL, statistical analysis, audience segmentation, and AI-enabled analytics to uncover retention and conversion opportunities, develop actionable audience segments for testing and personalization, and enable stakeholders to explore trusted data through conversational and self-service analytics tools built on BigQuery, dbt, and modern AI workflows.

What You’ll Do

Analyze user engagement and retention patterns using behavioral data in BigQuery, applying lightweight statistical models (e.g., logistic regression, survival analysis) to identify drivers of conversion, churn risk, and lifetime value Develop and operationalize audience segments using clustering and propensity modeling (e.g., k-means, logistic regression) within dbt/SQL workflows, enabling targeted activation and personalization across marketing and product channels
Help business users effectively explore data using AI tools - translate stakeholder questions into structured data models and AI-ready datasets, ensuring alignment with standardized metrics and business logic Build and maintain AI-enabled self-service analytics workflows (e.g., NLQ in Hex using BigQuery/dbt models) that allow stakeholders to answer business questions without using SQL
Develop and document curated datasets and semantic definitions that improve the accuracy and usability of AI-generated insights
Iterate on data models and documentation based on stakeholder usage patterns and feedback from AI-assisted analysis
Consult with Product Managers on digital product performance measurement
Partner with engineering to ensure AI tools are properly connected to governed data sources (e.g., dbt models in BigQuery), improving trust and adoption
Present new capabilities and analyses to senior leaders and less technical audiences inside The Inquirer, and serve as a trusted partner for stakeholder outreach
Contribute to an inclusive and positive work environment

Who We Are Looking For

5+ years of experience in product analytics, business intelligence, or a similar analytical role.
Proficiency in SQL for querying and analyzing large datasets.
Experience with Python or R for statistical analysis and data manipulation.
Strong background in A/B testing methodologies and experimentation.
Experience with event tracking and analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Adobe Analytics).
Excellent communication and storytelling skills to consult with stakeholders and translate complex data into actionable insights.
Ability to work cross-functionally and influence product roadmaps through data.

About Us.

The Philadelphia Inquirer is the media brand of record in Philadelphia and the region, and the largest news media organization in the state of Pennsylvania. A daily habit for almost 200 years, The Inquirer delivers Pulitzer Prize-winning news, sports, food, and lifestyle journalism multi-platform: Inquirer.com, Inquirer newspaper, e-editions, apps, newsletters, social, video, podcasts, and live events, generating 15M monthly impressions. Locally owned and headquartered in Philadelphia, no media brand is more deeply connected to the city or better understands what drives it. Our influence also extends across key drive markets, including Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, and New York, as well as to Philadelphia expats who live across the country and root for the Eagles, Phillies, Sixers, Flyers, and the Union.

Support proposal and project setup activities.

Coordinate with Equipment and Procurement teams to secure vehicles, tools, and equipment needed for project execution.

Test the limits of your brain for the most innovative health systems on the planet.

Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.

Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. More than just important work
.

Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.

High School Diploma or equivalent.

Customer service focus, with excellent interpersonal skills.

Physical Activities: Ability to perform tasks that require, walking, bending, reaching, crouching, kneeling, climb, squat, crawl, lift above shoulder, reach, and twist.

Repetitive Motions: Continuous repetitive motion and tasks involving L/R hand movement (computer/mouse), wrists, or arms (e.g., typing, data entry).

Indoor office setting for corporate roles, including working with standard office equipment (computers, phones, printers). May involve regular meetings, (in person or zoom) and collaboration with team members.

Outdoor fieldwork at restoration sites, which may include residential, commercial, or industrial properties. Duties may involve exposure to different weather conditions (sun, rain, snow, heat).

Potential exposure to hazardous materials, chemicals, or contaminants specific to restoration work, requiring strict adherence to safety protocols and use of PPE.
Work after hours and weekends given our 24/7 business operations

May include travel to and from job sites, requiring the use of company vehicles. Possibility of attending out-of-town training or conferences.

About Acrisure

Acrisure Enterprise Technology Group is where human expertise meets advanced technology.

A global fintech leader, Acrisure empowers millions of ambitious businesses and individuals with the right solutions to grow boldly forward. Bringing cutting-edge technology and top-tier human support together, we connect clients with customized solutions across a range of insurance, reinsurance, payroll, benefits, cybersecurity, mortgage services – and more.

In the last twelve years, Acrisure has grown in revenue from $38 million to almost $5 billion and employs over 19,000 colleagues in more than 20 countries. Acrisure was built on entrepreneurial spirit. Prioritizing leadership, accountability, and collaboration, we equip our teams to work at the highest levels possible.

The Role

The Analytics organization is chartered with advancing data driven decision making across Acrisure. As a member of the team, you will be responsible for leading the requirements gathering, design, implementation and delivery of reporting and analytics capabilities for Customer Success and Digital Solutions. You will be comfortable working across a wide variety of people including senior executive leadership, analysts, program management, and technical team members.

Here are some of the ways in which you’ll achieve impact:

Drive the development of efficient and reliable reporting and analytics capabilities with a data as a product and customer-first mindset.
Advance the transition of users from legacy means of accessing information to the future state strategies of data enablement and self-service with applied analytics.
Design and maintain internal SDKs, dashboards and reusable data libraries that enable stakeholders, analysts and engineers to access curated datasets with consistency and confidence.
Champion a developer-experience mindset by gathering feedback from SDK consumers, iterating on interfaces, and providing documentation and onboarding resources that scale knowledge across the team
Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate SDK, Dashboards, and analytics via Palantir.
Create presentation/visualization of data to see beyond the numbers while transforming data into actionable insights and recommendations.
Identify, adopt, and evangelize data analysis best practices and technical standards.
Advocate for and identify creative implementations to optimize business impact.
Empower others to grow understanding of the complexity of data by creatively scaling how teams’ knowledge is shared and applied
Help identify better practices, tools, and relevant trends that can improve data quality across the business.

You may be a fit for this role if you have:

5+ years of industry experience as a Data Analyst or Business Intelligence Professional serving the finance and accounting business functions.
A passion for building remarkable things with data.
Demonstrated ability to be a data storyteller and can go deep in building data visualizations and reporting using third party tools (Tableau and PowerBI).
Strong understanding of data models, structures, theories, principles, and practices.
Proficiency working with stakeholders to gather requirements, understand process and translate them to data and create/evaluate associated KPIs.
Experience with AI, SQL, Python, PowerBI, Tableau, dbt, BigQuery, Git, Palantir and data modeling
Experience with agile project execution and business tools such as Jira & ServiceNow
Have excellent communication and leadership skills and can unpack complex problems in order to find solutions.
Ability to understand the business purpose or problem behind a request.
Positive & creative problem solving in the face of data challenges.
Flexibility to successfully multi-task in a fast-paced environment with a positive attitude.
Strong teamwork, solution-centric, and customer-service-oriented attitude.
Possess empathy, kindness towards others, a positive attitude, and self-awareness.
Have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.

Candidates should be comfortable with an on-site presence to support collaboration, team leadership, and cross-functional partnership.

We are seeking an analytically rigorous and business-oriented Lead Data Analyst to help transform how our newsroom, product, marketing, and advertising teams use data to grow digital subscriptions and audience engagement. This role combines SQL, statistical analysis, audience segmentation, and AI-enabled analytics to uncover retention and conversion opportunities, develop actionable audience segments for testing and personalization, and enable stakeholders to explore trusted data through conversational and self-service analytics tools built on BigQuery, dbt, and modern AI workflows.

What You’ll Do

Analyze user engagement and retention patterns using behavioral data in BigQuery, applying lightweight statistical models (e.g., logistic regression, survival analysis) to identify drivers of conversion, churn risk, and lifetime value Develop and operationalize audience segments using clustering and propensity modeling (e.g., k-means, logistic regression) within dbt/SQL workflows, enabling targeted activation and personalization across marketing and product channels
Help business users effectively explore data using AI tools - translate stakeholder questions into structured data models and AI-ready datasets, ensuring alignment with standardized metrics and business logic Build and maintain AI-enabled self-service analytics workflows (e.g., NLQ in Hex using BigQuery/dbt models) that allow stakeholders to answer business questions without using SQL
Develop and document curated datasets and semantic definitions that improve the accuracy and usability of AI-generated insights
Iterate on data models and documentation based on stakeholder usage patterns and feedback from AI-assisted analysis
Consult with Product Managers on digital product performance measurement
Partner with engineering to ensure AI tools are properly connected to governed data sources (e.g., dbt models in BigQuery), improving trust and adoption
Present new capabilities and analyses to senior leaders and less technical audiences inside The Inquirer, and serve as a trusted partner for stakeholder outreach
Contribute to an inclusive and positive work environment

Who We Are Looking For

5+ years of experience in product analytics, business intelligence, or a similar analytical role.
Proficiency in SQL for querying and analyzing large datasets.
Experience with Python or R for statistical analysis and data manipulation.
Strong background in A/B testing methodologies and experimentation.
Experience with event tracking and analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Adobe Analytics).
Excellent communication and storytelling skills to consult with stakeholders and translate complex data into actionable insights.
Ability to work cross-functionally and influence product roadmaps through data.

About Us.

The Philadelphia Inquirer is the media brand of record in Philadelphia and the region, and the largest news media organization in the state of Pennsylvania. A daily habit for almost 200 years, The Inquirer delivers Pulitzer Prize-winning news, sports, food, and lifestyle journalism multi-platform: Inquirer.com, Inquirer newspaper, e-editions, apps, newsletters, social, video, podcasts, and live events, generating 15M monthly impressions. Locally owned and headquartered in Philadelphia, no media brand is more deeply connected to the city or better understands what drives it. Our influence also extends across key drive markets, including Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, and New York, as well as to Philadelphia expats who live across the country and root for the Eagles, Phillies, Sixers, Flyers, and the Union.

Lake Superior Consulting is seeking a Project Coordinator to join our growing team!

The Project Coordinator will support the execution of Corrosion Control projects focused on corrosion protection, inspection and testing services, and regulatory compliance initiatives. Typical projects may include Cathodic Protection Design, AC Mitigation Design, and Regulatory/Inspection Services.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys organization, coordination, and supporting technical project teams in a collaborative environment. The Project Coordinator will play a key role in supporting project execution, tracking schedules and costs, and helping ensure projects remain aligned with scope, timelines, and client expectations.

Responsibilities

Support proposal and project setup activities.
Develop and maintain project schedules and staffing plans throughout the project lifecycle.
Coordinate with Equipment and Procurement teams to secure vehicles, tools, and equipment needed for project execution.
Assist with project cost tracking and reporting activities.
Coordinate with Accounting and Project Managers to gather and maintain accurate project cost information.
Track project schedule and cost performance for use in status reporting.
Maintain consistency in project reporting across service areas.
Support project reporting efforts utilizing Earned Value Management principles.
Assist with project closeout activities and lessons learned documentation.
Support field project kickoffs and collaborate with field teams as needed to better understand project scope, operations, and client needs.
Manage smaller projects from initiation through closeout with support from Project Management leadership, including:
Proposal development
Budget and baseline schedule tracking
Project requirements coordination (operator qualifications, equipment, reporting, etc.)
Client and internal status updates
Invoicing support
Deliverable coordination and project closeout

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education/experience in a related field.
2+ years of experience supporting or executing field-based project work preferred.
Interest in developing project management skills and experience.
Basic understanding of integrity management and/or pipeline-related work scopes preferred.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, and MS Project.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Strong organizational and customer service skills.
High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.

Tuition reimbursement
